name: guided_intake_commercial
description: The GUIDED front door (doc 40), commercial: bill + EOB + card + SBC through /v1/intake/*, the planner choosing every screen. Asserts the infer-first rules end to end — the planner READS the card itself (the harness never asks it to): the member ID is a confident read and is kept, while the payer is one the extractor does not know, so it is a LOW-confidence read and arrives PRE-FILLED on the 'which insurer' screen for the user to confirm (never silent, never discarded); the SBC is on file and carries its Coverage Period (no plan-rules ask, no plan-year ask); the confirmed EOB stack resolves the accumulators (no manual deductible / out-of-pocket asks) — then READY → the SHARED audit and reveal, with every finding attributed to a side (§C14). A high-confidence payer (no 'which insurer' at all) is covered by runtime/tests/test_intake_routes.py. Needs --intake-mode guided.
